SOURCE-ASSISTED SELECTED READING, F-h8oz

Reader: a research reader (Claude), October 2026, reading the native fragment images with Arras Ms 590 fol. 66v, Reims Ms 708 fols. 91r-92v and the Venice 1588 print fols. 204v-205r available. Not independent of those sources. No specialist review; accuracy unmeasured. Parentheses mark proposed expansions; square brackets mark uncertain or supplied readings; [...] marks unread text. Lines count from the top of each column.

Canvas 2 (labelled fol. [1]v), 2842 x 4241 pixels. Text order: this side precedes canvas 1.

Column a, native box 400,420,1000,800:
1  [et pars que non] uenit ad curiam expectet p(er) .xx. dies p(ar)tem adu(er)sam.
2  S(ed) pone q(uod) apparet auditorem impetratu(m) e(ss)e s(ed) n(on)
3  c(on)stat p(er) principale(m) aut p(er) p(ro)cur(atorem) fuit optentus nu(m)-
4  quid sufficiat uidet(ur) q(uod) n(on) cum h(ec) [c(on)stitucio] p(ar)tem u(e)l p(ro)cur(atorem)
5  requirat. S(ed) c(ontrarium) tenem(us) q(uia) c(um) auditor p(ro) li-
6  tigatore impetrat(ur) et litigator h(oc) ratu(m) h(abe)t h(ec) ratih(abiti)o

8  in c(om)missionib(us) quas p(a)p(a) facit in curia exprimi-
9  tur ad cuius instancia(m) sit datus auditor. ¶ Si simpli-

11 v(er)titur int(er) t(ales) sup(er) tali re audiat et diffiniat. ¶ Si
12 aut(em) sol(us) ip(s)e ap(pellatus) e(st) p(re)sens si uult q(uod) p(ro)cedatur alt(er)a
13 p(ar)te absente nec(ess)e h(abe)t ostendere de app(ellatione) et q(uod) t(em)p(or)a h(uius)
14 c(on)stit(utionis) s(er)uauit. [S(ed) ...] an appellatus qui uult q(uod)
15 p(ro)cedatur absente p(ar)te altera p(ro)bare d(ebet) adu(er)sariu(m)
16 ex ca(usa) l(egitti)ma et in scriptis et infra decendium appella(sse) [...]

Column a, lower part, native box 400,2400,1000,1120 (lines not numbered):
[...] C. de temp. app. l. ii. § ult(imo). P(ri)mu(m) dictu(m) magis placet.
¶ Item q(ueritur) de modo p(ro)bandi app(ellatione)m et alia q(ue) p(ar)s p(re)sens
h(abe)t nec(ess)e p(ro)bare ut possit altera p(ar)te absente p(ro)ce-
di. R(espondeo) p(ro)babit h(oc) p(er) i(n)strum(en)ta u(e)l acta publica p(er) tes-
tes p(er) litt(er)as executor(um) quib(us) credim(us) ex quo sunt
duo u(e)l plures. ar. i. de testi. cu(m) a nob(is) [...]
[...] p(ro)ba. post cessionem. Cauend(um)
[tamen est] q(uod) executores faciant suas litt(er)as p(er) mo-
dum actor(um) designando loca et t(em)p(or)a ut i. de p(ro)ba.
q(uonia)m c(ontra). n(on) aut(em) p(er) mod(um) relac(i)o(n)is cui n(on) credit(ur) n(isi) multa
interueniant que in relac(i)o(n)e requiruntur q(uod) fiat p(re)-
sente p(ar)te altera et copiam recipiente et alia de
quib(us) hes i. de ap. intimasti [...]
[...] nu(m)quid p(ar)s absens uocabitur si p(re)sens p(er)
testes u(e)l alio modo app(ellatione)m et alia p(re)d(ic)ta p(ro)bare [...]
[...] absencia n(on) obstante [...]
[...] approbati e(st) q(uod) in audie(n)cia p(ar)s absens
antequa(m) in aliquo p(ro)cedatur citet(ur). ¶ It(em) q(ueritur)
s(i) sufficiat si p(ar)s p(re)sens p(ro)bet app(ellatione)m p(er) unu(m) teste(m)
et p(er) litt(er)am qua(m) p(ro)cur(ator) p(ar)tis absentis datus ad
impetrand(um) et c(ontra)dicendu(m) impetrare [intendit] [...]

Column b, native box 1420,1440,1000,600:
[ad defensionem] iur(is) sui ut dixi. ¶ [Si autem?] tu [mihi?] obicias q(ua)re non
appellantes uenire debent ex quo ex c(er)ta c(aus)a q(ue) n(on) tan-
gebat eos u(e)l q(uam) ueram forte n(on) credeba(n)t sciebant ap(pellatum)
e(ss)e. R(espondeo) q(uia) scire debebant q(uod) appellat(us) poterat ex b(e)n(e)fic(i)o
hui(us) iur(is) principale i(n) iudic(ium) deducere omisso app(ellationis) ar-
ticulo ut sup(ra) dixi. Unde q(ui)cu(m)q(ue) sciebat ap(pellatum) e(ss)e ue-
nire debebat ius suu(m) defensurus [...]
[...] ff. loca(ti) l. si
quis domu(m). P(apa) tame(n) no(tat) hic q(uod) l(ice)t [appellatus] c(ontra) appel-
la(n)tem possit petere ut s(ibi) sup(er) sua c(on)dic(i)o(n)e silenciu(m)
i(m)ponat(ur) si tamen uelit petere sua(m) elec(tione)m u(e)l p(ro)uisio(nem)
confirmari n(on) d(ebet) admitti [talis petitio nisi uocatis omnibus quos res tangit] [...]
